verifactu.title: VERI*FACTU
verifactu.description: Set up Fiskaly SIGN ES to automatically share invoices with the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) and comply with VERI*FACTU requirements. Enter the details of the representative to create a social collaboration agreement, which authorises bsport to transmit invoices on your behalf.

alert.content:
Heads up: Please review details carefully
Once you create your Social Collaboration Agreement, you won't be able to edit it unless you create another with a new signature. Please ensure all information is correct before you continue.

requirements.vat_description: Add your VAT ID in Settings -> Company to set up VERI*FACTU
requirements.address_description: Provide your business address as part of the Stripe onboarding to set up VERI*FACTU
requirements.vat_and_address_description: Add your VAT ID in Settings -> Company and complete your Stripe onboarding to provide your business address. Both are required by Spanish tax authorities before setting up VERI*FACTU.
requirements.legal_identifier_description: Speak to your Account Manager to set up invoice identifiers for Sign-ES.

sequentialNumbering.title: Set up sequential invoice numbering
sequentialNumbering.subtitle: Your invoices will be automatically numbered in sequence (1, 2, 3...). Set the start date and numbering format to get started.
sequentialNumbering.warning: <0>Heads up:</0> You won't be able to change this later. Please review carefully before clicking 'Save'.
sequentialNumbering.infoNextMonth: Invoices created before this date will keep their current numbers.
sequentialNumbering.infoCurrentMonth: If you choose 'Beginning of the current month' as the start date, all invoices will be retroactively numbered from this date. All invoices created before will stay the same.
sequentialNumbering.prefixSuffixHelper: Maximum 7 characters including letters, numbers and hyphens only.
sequentialNumbering.startingNumberHelper: Choose which number to start your invoices from and they'll be numbered sequentially (e.g. 1, 2, 3)
sequentialNumbering.startingNumberHelperExisting: Enter the next invoice number (one higher than your last invoice)
sequentialNumbering.previousInvoiceTitle: Last invoice number from previous month: <0>{{invoiceNumber}}</0>
sequentialNumbering.startingNumberHint: Find this invoice's number in your external accounting system.
sequentialNumbering.numberingExplanation: Each new invoice will be automatically sequenced by 1. For example, if you start at 1, your invoices will be numbered 000001, 000002, 000003, and so on.
sequentialNumbering.previewFirstLine: Your invoices will be numbered as follows: <0>{{firstNumber}}</0>
